translations.answer: A user successfully downgraded from Isaac Lab 2.2.1 to 2.2.0 and confirmed it on a 5070 Ti, but the original questioner still encountered a KeyError when using the same major version. Another user reported that Lab 2.2.1 and Isaac Sim 5.0 are now operational. Therefore, this combination is a candidate, and it must be verified alongside rsl-rl-lib, installation methods, project submission, and actual tasks.
translations.applicability: Only applicable to the Isaac Sim/Lab combinations listed in the comments; the conclusion is subject to same-thread counterexamples.
translations.credibility.rationale: The answer has not been closed or there is a conflict in the source; the conclusion is not fully resolved.
translations.details.attempts.0: Downgrade Isaac Lab; switch Isaac Sim/Lab combination; reinstall using official pip documentation and set project PYTHONPATH; fix rsl-rl-lib to 2.2.0 or 2.3.0.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Record Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, rsl-rl-lib, Python, installation method, and project submission; do not just record the major version of Isaac Lab; retest on Isaac-Ant-v0 and project task.
translations.details.environments.0: Original post: Isaac Sim 5.0.0, Isaac Lab version 0.47.1, Python 3.11; comments involve Isaac Lab 2.1.0/2.2.0/2.2.1, Isaac Sim 4.5/5.0, rsl-rl-lib 2.2.0/2.3.0, Ubuntu 22.04, RTX 5070/5070 Ti.
translations.details.limits.0: No maintenance response for the issue; no locked file or minimal reproducible repository; the 0.47.1 from the original post and the 2.x naming in the comments are not explained, so the conclusion cannot be used to recommend a single version.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Different participants reported incompatible success/failure combinations on different machines; the only common conclusion is that the entire dependency matrix must be verified together.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Tracking-Flat-G1-v0 throws KeyError: obs_groups during OnPolicyRunner initialization; should we switch to Isaac Lab/Sim or update rsl-rl?
translations.details.symptoms.0: rsl_rl/runners/on_policy_runner.py throws KeyError when accessing self.cfg['obs_groups']; some combinations fix the KeyError but then the infos['observations'] missing rnd_state.
translations.source.title: Version combination experience for obs_groups KeyError is conflicting
translations.title: Can we stabilize the obs_groups KeyError by downgrading Isaac Lab 2.2.1 to 2.2.0 while retaining Isaac Sim 5.0?
